t: Erbauer twin pack containing ECCD18-Li combi drill and ECID18-Li impact driver. Featuring brushless motors for maximum speed, power and motor life. Combi drill offers drilling in wood, steel and masonry, with a maximum torque of 50Nm. Impact driver with 1/4” hexagonal bit holder delivers up to 160Nm. Both tools also have a convenient LED light, with pre-light and after-glow to illuminate the area for precise working. Supplied in blow-moulded case.
